comparison.objective: Mount the final section of a bicycle tire bead without pinching the tube.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold bead arcs in the rim center channel while rolling the tight final section over the flange.
comparison.success_condition: Bead fully seated, valve aligned, hands off, and no prohibited lever intrusion, forcing, or tube damage.
comparison.reason: This is compliant/deformable bead management using geometry-created slack, unlike rigid damper adjustment and quantitative dynamic validation.
